verses.geez: ረዲ፡ ወንበሪ፡ ውስተ፡ ምድር፡ አንቲ፡ ድንግል፡ ወለተ፡ ባቢሎን፤ ንበሪ፡ ውስተ፡ መሬት፡ ወአልብኪ፡ መንበረ፡ ወለተ፡ ፋርስ፤ ወኢትሰመዪ፡ እንከ፡ ልሕደ፡ ወስብሕት።
verses.translation: Come down, sit on the ground, O virgin daughter of Babylon: sit on the ground, O daughter of the Chaldeans: for thou shalt no more be called tender and luxurious.

translations.lxx: Come down, sit on the ground, O virgin daughter of Babylon: sit on the ground, O daughter of the Chaldeans: for thou shalt no more be called tender and luxurious.
translations.kjv: Come down, and sit in the dust, O virgin daughter of Babylon, sit on the ground: there is no throne, O daughter of the Chaldeans: for thou shalt no more be called tender and delicate.
translations.ron: "Coboară-te şi şezi în ţărână, fecioară, fiica Babilonului, stai pe pământ fără tron, fiică a Caldeilor, că nu te va mai numi nimeni pe tine gingaşă şi plăcută!
translations.grk: Κατάβηθι, κάθισον ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν παρθένος θυγάτηρ Βαβυλῶνος, κάθισον εἰς τὴν γῆν θυγάτηρ Χαλδαίων, ὅτι οὐκέτι προστεθήσῃ κληθῆναι ἁπαλὴ καὶ τρυφερά.

verses.geez: ንሥኢ፡ ማሕረፀ፡ ወሕርፂ፡ ሐሪፀ፤ ከሥቲ፡ ግልባቤኪ፡ ወያስተርኢ፡ ሢበትኪ፤ ሰሐቢ፡ አቍያጸኪ፡ ወዕድዊ፡ አፍላገ።
verses.translation: Take a millstone, grind meal: remove thy veil, uncover thy white hairs, make bare the leg, pass through the rivers.

translations.lxx: Take a millstone, grind meal: remove thy veil, uncover thy white hairs, make bare the leg, pass through the rivers.
translations.kjv: Take the millstones, and grind meal: uncover thy locks, make bare the leg, uncover the thigh, pass over the rivers.
translations.ron: Învârteşte la râşniţă şi macină făină, dă-ţi la o parte vălul tău, ridică-şi veşmântul tău, rămâi cu picioarele goale şi treci râurile!
translations.grk: Λάβε μύλον, ἄλεσον ἄλευρον, ἀποκὸλυψαι τὸ κατακάλυμμά σου, ἀνακάλυψαι τὰς πολιὰς, ἀνάσυρε τὰς κνήμας, διάβηθι ποταμούς.

verses.geez: ይትቀፈጽ፡ ኃፍረትኪ፡ ወያስተርኢ፡ ኃሣርኪ፤ እስመ፡ ይነሥእዋ፡ ለጽድቅ፡ እምኔኪ፡ ወኢይሁብ፡ እንከ፡ ሰብአ፡ ህየንቴኪ።
verses.translation: Thy shame shall be uncovered, thy reproaches shall be brought to light: I will exact of thee due vengeance, I will no longer deliver thee to men.

translations.lxx: Thy shame shall be uncovered, thy reproaches shall be brought to light: I will exact of thee due vengeance, I will no longer deliver thee to men.
translations.kjv: Thy nakedness shall be uncovered, yea, thy shame shall be seen: I will take vengeance, and I will not meet thee as a man.
translations.ron: Goliciunea ta să se descopere, să se vadă ruşinea ta. Mă voi răzbuna şi nu voi cruţa pe nimeni",
translations.grk: Ἀνακαλυφθήσεται ἡ αἰσχύνη σου, φανήσονται οἱ ὀνειδισμοί σου· τὸ δίκαιον ἐκ σοῦ λήμψομαι, οὐκέτι μὴ παραδῶ ἀνθρώποις.

verses.geez: ዘአድኀነኪ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ጸባኦት፡ ስሙ፣፡ ቅዱስ፡ እስራኤል።
verses.translation: Thy deliverer is the Lord of hosts, the Holy One of Israel is his name.

translations.lxx: Thy deliverer is the Lord of hosts, the Holy One of Israel is his name.
translations.kjv: As for our redeemer, the LORD of hosts is his name, the Holy One of Israel.
translations.ron: Zice Izbăvitorul nostru; Domnul Savaot este numele Lui, Sfântul lui Israel!
translations.grk: Ὁ ῥυσάμενός σε Κύριος σαβαὼθ, ὄνομα αὐτῷ Ἅγιος Ἰσραήλ.

verses.geez: ንበሪ፡ ድንግፅተኪ፡ ወባኢ፡ ውስተ፡ ጽልመት፡ ወለተ፡ ፋርስ፤ ወኢትሰመዪ፡ እንከ፡ ኃይለ፡ መንግሥት።
verses.translation: Sit thou down pierced with woe, go into darkness, O daughter of the Chaldeans: thou shalt no more be called the strength of a kingdom.

translations.lxx: Sit thou down pierced with woe, go into darkness, O daughter of the Chaldeans: thou shalt no more be called the strength of a kingdom.
translations.kjv: Sit thou silent, and get thee into darkness, O daughter of the Chaldeans: for thou shalt no more be called, The lady of kingdoms.
translations.ron: "Stai tăcută şi mai la întuneric, fiică a Caldeilor, nimeni nu te va mai chema pe tine stăpâna regatelor".
translations.grk: Κάθισον κατανενυγμένη, εἴσελθε εἰς τὸ σκότος θύγατεηρ Χαλδαίων, οὐκέτι μὴ κληθήσῃ ἰσχὺς βασιλείας.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ተዘኀርኪ፡ ዲበ፡ ሕዝብየ፡ ወአርኰስኪ፡ ርስትየ።
verses.translation: I have been provoked with my people; thou hast defiled mine inheritance: I gave them into thy hand, but thou didst not extend mercy to them: thou madest the yoke of the aged man very heavy,

translations.lxx: I have been provoked with my people; thou hast defiled mine inheritance: I gave them into thy hand, but thou didst not extend mercy to them: thou madest the yoke of the aged man very heavy,
translations.kjv: I was wroth with my people, I have polluted mine inheritance, and given them into thine hand: thou didst shew them no mercy; upon the ancient hast thou very heavily laid thy yoke.
translations.ron: Mâniat am fost pe poporul Meu, pângărit-am moştenirea Mea şi am dat-o în mâna ta. Dar tu n-ai avut milă şi asupra bătrânului ai apăsat cu jug greu.
translations.grk: Παρωξύνθην ἐπὶ τῷ λαῷ μου, ἐμίανας τὴν κληρονομίαν μου· ἐγὼ ἔδωκα αὐτοὺς εἰς τὴν χεῖρά σου, σὺ δὲ οὐκ ἔδωκας αὐτοῖς ἔλεος, τοῦ πρεσβυτέρου ἐβάρυνας τὸν ζυγὸν σφόδρα,

verses.translation: and saidst, I shall be a princess for ever: thou didst not perceive these things in thine heart, nor didst thou remember the latter end.

translations.lxx: and saidst, I shall be a princess for ever: thou didst not perceive these things in thine heart, nor didst thou remember the latter end.
translations.kjv: And thou saidst, I shall be a lady for ever: so that thou didst not lay these things to thy heart, neither didst remember the latter end of it.
translations.ron: Şi tu îţi închipuiai: "Fi-voi pe veci stăpână!", dar niciodată n-ai cugetat şi de sfârşit nu ti-ai adus aminte!
translations.grk: καὶ εἶπας, εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα ἔσομαι ἄρχουσα· οὐκ ἐνόησας ταῦτα ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ σου, οὐδὲ ἐμνήσθης τὰ ἔσχατα.

verses.geez: ወይእዜኒ፡ ስምዒ፡ ዘንተ፡ አንቲ፡ ልሕድ፡ እንተ፡ ትነብሪ፡ ተአሚነኪ፣፡ እንተ፡ ትብሊ፡ በልብኪ፤ አነ፡ ይእቲ፡ ወአልቦ፡ እንተ፡ ከማየ፤ ኢይከውን፡ መበለተ፡ ወኢይመውቱ፡ ውሉድየ።
verses.translation: But now hear these words, thou luxurious one, who art the one that sits at ease, that is secure, that says in her heart, I am, and there is not another; I shall not sit a widow, neither shall I know bereavement.

translations.lxx: But now hear these words, thou luxurious one, who art the one that sits at ease, that is secure, that says in her heart, I am, and there is not another; I shall not sit a widow, neither shall I know bereavement.
translations.kjv: Therefore hear now this, thou that art given to pleasures, that dwellest carelessly, that sayest in thine heart, I am, and none else beside me; I shall not sit as a widow, neither shall I know the loss of children:
translations.ron: Şi acum ascultă, tu cea în plăceri crescută, care stăpâneai fără de grijă şi ziceai în inima ta: "Nimeni alta nu este ca mine! Nu voi rămâne văduvă şi nu voi şti ce este lipsa de copii!"
translations.grk: Νῦν δὲ ἄκουε ταῦτα τρυφερὰ, ἡ καθημένη, ἡ πεποιθυῖα, ἡ λέγουσα ἐν καρδίᾳ αὐτῆς, ἐγώ εἰμι, καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν ἑτέρα, οὐ καθιῶ χήρα, οὐδὲ γνώσομαι ὀρφανίαν.

verses.geez: ይእዜኒ፡ ይመጽኡ፡ እሉ፡ ክልኤሆሙ፡ ኅቡረ፡ ላዕሌኪ፡ በአሐቲ፡ ዕለት፤ ወትከውኒ፡ መበለተ፡ ወይመውቱ፡ ውሉድኪ።
verses.translation: But now these two things shall come upon thee suddenly in one day, the loss of children and widowhood shall come suddenly upon thee, for thy sorcery, for the strength of thine enchantments,

translations.lxx: But now these two things shall come upon thee suddenly in one day, the loss of children and widowhood shall come suddenly upon thee, for thy sorcery, for the strength of thine enchantments,
translations.kjv: But these two things shall come to thee in a moment in one day, the loss of children, and widowhood: they shall come upon thee in their perfection for the multitude of thy sorceries, and for the great abundance of thine enchantments.
translations.ron: Şi aceste două într-o clipă, în aceeaşi zi, vor da peste tine: lipsa de copii şi văduvia; şi te vor copleşi cu toată mulţimea şi puterea fermecătoriilor şi vrăjitoriilor tale!
translations.grk: Νῦν δὲ ἥξει ἐπὶ σὲ τὰ δύο ταῦτα ἐξαίφνης ἐν ἡμέρᾳ μιᾷ, ἀτεκνία καὶ χηρεία ἥξει ἐξαίφνης ἐπὶ σὲ, ἐν τῇ φαρμακείᾳ σου, ἐν τῇ ἰσχύϊ τῶν ἐπαοιδῶν σου σφόδρα,

verses.translation: for thy trusting in wickedness: for thou saidst, I am, and there is not another: know thou, the understanding of these things and thy harlotry shall be thy shame; for thou saidst in thy heart, I am, and there is not another.

translations.lxx: for thy trusting in wickedness: for thou saidst, I am, and there is not another: know thou, the understanding of these things and thy harlotry shall be thy shame; for thou saidst in thy heart, I am, and there is not another.
translations.kjv: For thou hast trusted in thy wickedness: thou hast said, None seeth me. Thy wisdom and thy knowledge, it hath perverted thee; and thou hast said in thine heart, I am, and none else beside me.
translations.ron: intru fărădelegile tale tu nădăjduiai şi ziceai: "Nimeni nu mă vede!" Înţelepciunea ta şi ştiinţa ta te-au amăgit astfel, că ziceai în inima ta: "Eu şi nimeni alta nu este ca mine!"
translations.grk: τῇ ἐλπίδι τῆς πονηρίας σου· σὺ γὰρ εἶπας, ἐγώ εἰμι, καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν ἑτέρα· γνῶθι, ἡ σύνεσις τούτων ἔσται, καὶ ἡ πορνεία σου σοὶ αἰσχύνη· καὶ εἶπας τῇ καρδίᾳ σου, ἐγώ εἰμι, καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν ἑτέρα.

verses.geez: ወይመጽእ፡ ሕርትምና፡ ላዕሌኪ፡ ወኢተአምሪ፤ ዕመቂሁ፡ ወትወድቂ፡ ውስቴቱ፤ ወይመጽአኪ፡ ኃሣር፡ ወኢትክሊ፡ አምሥጦ፤ ወይመጽአኪ፡ ግብተ፡ ሞት፡ ወኢተአምሪ።
verses.translation: And destruction shall come upon thee, and thou shalt not be aware; there shall be a pit, and thou shalt fall into it: and grief shall come upon thee, and thou shalt not be able to be clear; and destruction shall come suddenly upon thee, and thou shalt not know.

translations.lxx: And destruction shall come upon thee, and thou shalt not be aware; there shall be a pit, and thou shalt fall into it: and grief shall come upon thee, and thou shalt not be able to be clear; and destruction shall come suddenly upon thee, and thou shalt not know.
translations.kjv: Therefore shall evil come upon thee; thou shalt not know from whence it riseth: and mischief shall fall upon thee; thou shalt not be able to put it off: and desolation shall come upon thee suddenly, which thou shalt not know.
translations.ron: Drept aceea va veni peste tine o nenorocire pe care tu nu vei şti să o înlături cu frumuseţea ta şi te va copleşi nenorocirea pe care tu nu o vei putea ocoli şi pe neaşteptate va da peste tine pieirea, fără să fi avut vreme s-o prevesteşti!
translations.grk: Καὶ ἥξει ἐπὶ σὲ ἀπώλεια, καὶ οὐ μὴ γνῷς· βόθυνος, καὶ ἐμπεσῇ εἰς αὐτόν· καὶ ἥξει ἐπὶ σὲ ταλαιπωρία, καὶ οὐ μὴ δυνήσῃ καθαρὰ γενέσθαι· καὶ ἥξει ἐπὶ σὲ ἐξαπίνης ἀπώλεια, καὶ οὐ μὴ γνώσῃ.

verses.geez: ቁሚኬ፡ ይእዚ፡ በሰገልኪ፡ ወበብዝኅ፡ ሥራያትኪ፡ ዘተመሀርኪ፡ እምንእስኪ፡ ዘኢይበቍዐኪ፡ እመቦ፡ ዘይክል፡ አድኅኖተኪ።
verses.translation: Stand now with thine enchantments, and with the abundance of thy sorcery, which thou hast learned from thy youth; if thou canst be profited.

translations.lxx: Stand now with thine enchantments, and with the abundance of thy sorcery, which thou hast learned from thy youth; if thou canst be profited.
translations.kjv: Stand now with thine enchantments, and with the multitude of thy sorceries, wherein thou hast laboured from thy youth; if so be thou shalt be able to profit, if so be thou mayest prevail.
translations.ron: Păstrează pentru tine fermecătoriile tale şi vrăjitoriile cu care te-ai trudit din tinereţe, poate îţi vor sluji, poate vei insufla temere!
translations.grk: Στῆθι νῦν ἐν ταῖς ἐπαοιδαῖς σου, καὶ ἐν τῇ πολλῇ φαρμακείᾳ σου, ἃ ἐμάνθανες ἐκ νεότητός σου, εἰ δυνήσῃ ὠφεληθῆναι.

verses.geez: ሰራሕኪ፡ በምክርኪ፡ እኩይ፤ እስኩ፡ ይቁሙ፡ ወያድኅኑኪ፡ እለ፡ ያሰግሉ፡ ለኪ፡ ወይኔጽሩ፡ ሰማየ፡ ወይሬእዩ፡ በኮከበ፡ ሰማይ፣፡ ወይንግሩኪ፡ ምንተ፡ አመጽእ፡ ላዕሌኪ።
verses.translation: Thou art wearied in thy counsels. Let now the astrologers of the heaven stand and deliver thee, let them that see the stars tell thee what is about to come upon thee.

translations.lxx: Thou art wearied in thy counsels. Let now the astrologers of the heaven stand and deliver thee, let them that see the stars tell thee what is about to come upon thee.
translations.kjv: Thou art wearied in the multitude of thy counsels. Let now the astrologers, the stargazers, the monthly prognosticators, stand up, and save thee from these things that shall come upon thee.
translations.ron: Tu te-ai obosit întrebând pe atâţia sfătuitori! Să iasă la iveală şi să te izbăvească acei care măsoară cerul şi iscodesc stelele; care în fiecare lună nouă spun ceea ce se va întâmpla.
translations.grk: Κεκοπίακας ἐν ταῖς βουλαῖς σου· στήτωσαν δὴ καὶ σωσάτωσάν σε οἱ ἀστρολόγοι τοῦ οὐρανοῦ, οἱ ὁρῶντες τοὺς ἀστέρας ἀναγγειλάτωσάν σοι, τί μέλλει ἐπὶ σὲ ἔρχεσθαι.

verses.geez: ናሁ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ ይውዕዩ፡ ከመ፡ ሐሠር፡ ዘውስተ፡ እሳት፡ ወኢያድኅኑ፡ ነፍሶሙ፡ እምነበልባል፣፡ ወይከውኑኪ፡ አፍሐመ፡ እሳት፡ ወትነብሪ፡ ኀቤሆሙ።
verses.translation: Behold, they all shall be burnt up as sticks in the fire; neither shall they at all deliver their life from the flame. Because thou hast coals of fire, sit thou upon them;

translations.lxx: Behold, they all shall be burnt up as sticks in the fire; neither shall they at all deliver their life from the flame. Because thou hast coals of fire, sit thou upon them;
translations.kjv: Behold, they shall be as stubble; the fire shall burn them; they shall not deliver themselves from the power of the flame: there shall not be a coal to warm at, nor fire to sit before it.
translations.ron: Iată-i ca pleava pe care o mistuie focul, aşa vor ajunge ei şi de puterea flăcărilor viaţa lor nu vor putea s-o scape căci nu va fi jeratic la care să se încălzească, nici vatră ca să stea dinaintea ei.
translations.grk: Ἰδοὺ πάντες ὡς φρύγανα ἐπὶ πυρὶ κατακαυθήσονται, καὶ οὐ μὴ ἐξέλωνται τὴν ψυχὴν αὐτῶν ἐκ φλογός· ὅτι ἔχεις ἄνθρακας πυρός· κάθισαι ἐπʼ αὐτοὺς,

verses.geez: እሙንቱሰ፡ ይከውኑኪ፡ ረድኤተኪ፤ ሰራሕኪ፡ እምንእስኪ፤ ሰብእኒ፡ ዘስሕተ፡ ለርእሱ፣፡ ወአንቲሰ፡ አልብኪ፡ መድኃኒተ።
verses.translation: these shall be thy help. Thou hast wearied thyself with traffic from thy youth: every man has wandered to his own home, but thou shalt have no deliverance.

translations.lxx: these shall be thy help. Thou hast wearied thyself with traffic from thy youth: every man has wandered to his own home, but thou shalt have no deliverance.
translations.kjv: Thus shall they be unto thee with whom thou hast laboured, even thy merchants, from thy youth: they shall wander every one to his quarter; none shall save thee.
translations.ron: Aşa se va întâmpla cu aceia pe care te-ai ostenit să-i întrebi şi cu care ai făcut negoţ din vremea tinereţii tale. Fiecare va pleca la ale sale şi nimeni nu va fi să te scape".
translations.grk: οὗτοι ἔσονταί σοι βοήθεια· ἐκοπίασας ἐν τῇ μεταβολῇ ἐκ νεότητος, ἄνθρωπος καθʼ ἑαυτὸν ἐπλανήθη, σοὶ δὲ οὐκ ἔσται σωτηρία.
